text: note/body text is shell-evaluated at the call site — support file/stdin input

Forward note from field session: apply whatever input path is chosen (-F - / --body-file) uniformly to note, new -b, AND update body/text — those are the three places an agent dumps backtick-heavy prose, and inconsistent support just relocates the footgun. For agent callers, stdin (-F -) is the higher-value path: agents already heredoc into bash, so it drops in cleanly. Prioritize stdin if the work gets split.
